en.t: A fine drizzle was falling from the sky.

units.source_text: 从一大早就下下停停，停停下下。

en.t: Since early morning it had been raining off and on, stopping and starting again.

units.source_text: 风地轻轻吹拂，不那么闷热。

en.t: A light breeze was blowing, so it was not so muggy.

units.source_text: 菜园里的南瓜花在细雨中星星点点地绽开。

en.t: In the vegetable garden, pumpkin blossoms opened here and there like specks of stars in the fine rain.

units.source_text: 另一面，上月初开始播在黑油油的田埂上的大豆正在萌芽。

en.t: Meanwhile, the soybeans sown at the beginning of last month on the rich black ridges between the fields were beginning to sprout.
